_meta.description: SYNTHETIC evidence dataset for the Automated ESG Greenwashing Detection & Verification Agent.
_meta.note: All sources, filings, and news items below are fictional and created for academic development/testing purposes only. They do not describe any real company, regulator, or publication.

evidence.retrieved_text: Scope 1 emissions declined from 82,000 tCO2e in FY2023 to 49,200 tCO2e in FY2024, a reduction of approximately 40%, as reported under Principle 6 of the BRSR filing.
evidence.notes: Primary regulatory source; numbers match the claimed 40% reduction.

evidence.source: Independent Third-Party Emissions Assurance Statement FY2024
evidence.retrieved_text: The assurance provider confirms Scope 1 emissions data reported by GreenLeaf Renewables for FY2024 is materially accurate within a +/-2% margin.
evidence.notes: Independent audit corroborating the regulatory filing.

evidence.retrieved_text: Combined Scope 1 and Scope 2 emissions were 1.26 million tCO2e in FY2024, compared to 1.20 million tCO2e in FY2022, an increase of approximately 5%.
evidence.notes: Regulatory filing shows an increase, not a 25% reduction as claimed.

evidence.source: Business Herald India - Bharat Steelworks emissions story
evidence.retrieved_text: Bharat Steelworks announced a 25% cut in emissions in its latest sustainability update, citing efficiency gains at its Rourkela plant.
evidence.notes: This article restates the company's own press release; it is not an independent data source and should not be weighted the same as EVD-003.

evidence.source: State Pollution Control Board Emissions Monitoring Record
evidence.retrieved_text: Continuous emissions monitoring data submitted by Bharat Steelworks' Rourkela facility shows no material decline in Scope 1 emissions between FY2022 and FY2024.
evidence.notes: Independent regulator monitoring data, second source contradicting the claim.

evidence.retrieved_text: The Pune manufacturing facility sourced approximately 90% of its electricity consumption from on-site and contracted renewable sources during FY2024.
evidence.notes: 90% audited figure is reasonably close to the claimed 92%.

evidence.retrieved_text: Suryodaya Solar Energy proudly announces that over 90% of its Pune plant's power now comes from renewable sources.
evidence.notes: Company PR corroborates but is not independently weighted as strongly as the audit.

evidence.retrieved_text: GreenLeaf's roadmap targets 60% renewable electricity usage by 2027 as an interim milestone toward its 2030 goal, with no independently verified progress data published yet.
evidence.notes: Only a forward-looking roadmap exists; no evidence yet exists to confirm or deny a 2030 target, hence INSUFFICIENT_EVIDENCE at the claim level.

evidence.source: State Pollution Control Board Consent-to-Operate Certificate
evidence.retrieved_text: EcoCycle's Nagpur recycling facility is authorized to process a maximum of 50,000 tonnes of plastic waste per annum under its consent-to-operate certificate.
evidence.notes: The registered capacity (50,000 tonnes/year) is half of the 100,000 tonnes claimed as processed in a single year -- a capacity check failure.

evidence.retrieved_text: EcoCycle is proud to have processed 100,000 tonnes of plastic waste this year, reinforcing our commitment to the circular economy.
evidence.notes: This is the company's own claim restated; it conflicts with the regulator-verified capacity limit in EVD-008.

evidence.retrieved_text: Water withdrawal intensity fell from 5.2 to 4.29 kilolitres per tonne of product between FY2021 and FY2024, a reduction of approximately 17.5%.
evidence.notes: 17.5% audited figure closely matches the claimed 18%, within reasonable rounding.

evidence.retrieved_text: AquaPure highlights an 18% cut in water intensity per tonne of product since FY2021 as part of its water stewardship program.
evidence.notes: Corroborating but non-independent source.

evidence.retrieved_text: Vasundhara requires all Tier 1 suppliers to certify deforestation-free sourcing, but the policy does not extend formal verification to Tier 2 and Tier 3 suppliers.
evidence.notes: Policy exists for Tier 1 only; no evidence covers the 'entire supply chain' as claimed.

evidence.retrieved_text: Cotton-growing regions supplying several textile manufacturers, including some linked to Vasundhara's sub-suppliers, face ongoing scrutiny over land-clearing practices.
evidence.notes: Indirect, low-tier, and not specific enough to directly confirm or deny the company-level claim; contributes to INSUFFICIENT_EVIDENCE rather than a firm CONTRADICT.

evidence.retrieved_text: Women held 31% of senior management positions in FY2024, up from 20% in FY2022, as disclosed under Principle 5 of the BRSR filing.
evidence.notes: 31% vs claimed 32% and 20% vs claimed 21% are within normal rounding/reporting variance.

evidence.retrieved_text: The factory inspectorate recorded two fatal workplace accidents at Bharat Steelworks' Rourkela plant during FY2024.
evidence.notes: Directly contradicts the 'zero fatal accidents' claim.

evidence.retrieved_text: A worker died following an industrial accident at a Bharat Steelworks plant in Odisha in March 2024, local officials confirmed.
evidence.notes: Independent news report corroborating the regulator record from a different source type.

evidence.retrieved_text: Suryodaya Solar Energy Ltd's FY2024 BRSR report was filed with the stock exchanges on 31 May 2024 and is publicly available on the exchange disclosure portal.
evidence.notes: Filing confirmed present and on time.

evidence.retrieved_text: GreenLeaf Renewables announced a 40% cut in Scope 1 emissions for FY2024, according to its latest sustainability report.
evidence.notes: This article simply restates EVD-001/EVD-002's underlying filing; it must NOT be counted as an additional independent source when tallying evidence strength.

evidence.source: Industry Analyst Commentary - Clean Energy Insights
evidence.retrieved_text: Analysts note that GreenLeaf's 2030 all-renewable target is ambitious relative to sector peers, but caution that early-stage roadmaps often see delays.
evidence.notes: Commentary on credibility of a future target, not verification of a completed claim.
